description:
WHO WE ARE:  

Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DAWs and plugins, the Splice experience seamlessly integrates into any music production workflow, regardless of DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). Via Splice, an unparalleled team of sound designers and sample creators are fueling the success of a growing global community of chart-topping producers, students, and DIY creators.

HOW WE WORK:  

At Splice, DISCO is a rallying cry for collaboration, accountability, and unity within our organization; Direct, Inclusive, Splice Together, Creator Centric, and Optimistic. Our shared success depends on our ability to support one another, work well together, and communicate directly. By embracing flexibility and a unified approach, we can navigate anything that’s thrown at us.

Splice embraces a culture of remote work. You’ll see your colleagues showing up from across the US and the UK. In order to keep us working well as a team, we have regular communication, including Town Halls, departmental all-hands and get-togethers.

When you join Splice, you join a network of colleagues, peers, and collaborators. Are you ready?

Senior Marketing Manager, Mobile


LOCATION: Remote

THE ROLE:

In this role, you will be the primary marketing owner of our positioning, strategy, and execution across the full marketing funnel including user acquisition, activation, retention, and reporting. We are looking for a hands-on leader to move fast, make decisions with data, and efficiently grow the app's user base while optimizing for profitable LTV/CAC ratios.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

  • Set the growth strategy. Define the model, targets, and channel mix that take the app to its user and revenue goals, and own the growth roadmap and budget.
  • Scale acquisition. Build efficient paid (Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, Google UAC), organic, ASO, referral, influencer, and partnership channels, with clear CAC and payback targets.
  • Improve activation. Work with Product and Design to shorten time-to-value in onboarding and lift the share of installs that become active users.
  • Drive retention and engagement. Own lifecycle marketing (push, email, in-app messaging) and the cohort analysis that shows where users drop off and why.
  • Grow monetization. Partner with Product on paywall, pricing, and subscription experiments that raise conversion and LTV.
  • Run an experimentation program. Keep a prioritized backlog, a weekly test cadence, and a clear set of targets that define success.
  • Own measurement. Work with data to set up attribution (MMP, SKAN, incrementality), build trusted growth dashboards, and share results, progress, learnings, and next steps to the company and leadership team.
  • Lead competitive intelligence. Use a variety of analytics tools to monitor and manage competitive strategy and how we win across geos and platforms.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5-7+ years in growth or performance marketing, ideally at a consumer mobile app.
  • A record of scaling mobile app installs and revenue that map to strong CAC, payback, retention, and LTV targets.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of mobile paid channels and attribution, including MMPs and SKAdNetwork-era measurement.
  • Strong analytical skills: you're comfortable in SQL or BI tools and can design and read an A/B test without help.
  • Experience with lifecycle and retention programs, including push and in-app messaging.
  • Clear communication and the judgment to prioritize projects, define targets, and allocate budget appropriately.
  • Experience managing a monthly marketing budget to strict CAC and LTV targets including scale-sequencing as growth levers are identified.
  • Experience managing agencies and/or contractors that may be needed along the way to achieve our ambitious goals.
  • Experience leading content acquisition or influencer marketing programs, from recruiting and briefing creators to measuring campaign performance

 

NICE TO HAVES: 

  • Experience with subscription or freemium apps, including paywall and pricing tests.
  • Background in product-led growth, referral loops, or community-driven acquisition.
  • Experience at an early-stage startup, building growth from a small base.
  • Familiarity and connection with the music creation market.

SPLICE BENEFITS: 

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive pay with annual reviews and equity opportunities.
  • Time Off: Unlimited PTO to recharge and thrive.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with immediate vesting and company match.
  • Parental Support: 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for non-birthing parents, and 18-20 weeks for birthing parents.
  • Flexible Work Options: Work remotely or connect at our office hubs and creative spaces worldwide.
  • Professional Growth: Annual learning budget, leadership programs, and team ambassador opportunities.
  • Community & Connection: Inclusive events, team meet-ups, and vibrant Employee Resource Groups.

The national pay range for this role is $118,893 - $148,616. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience.
